name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
title: Vedant Fashions Ltd - 543463 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 retail sales up 7.8% with SSG 4.6% and FY26 gross openings flat, net store closures of 5-6% of area; supply is being cut, not expanded, but management gives no numeric FY27 guidance.

triggers.label: Store closures 5-6% of area FY26
triggers.quote: This year, we might again close 5% to 6% and still try to have net square feet positive growth.

triggers.label: 2022 entrants closing; net openings nil
triggers.quote: the players who had entered in 2022, they have started to close down

triggers.label: ASP lagged; upgrade 3-3.5% per category
triggers.quote: our ASPs have not moved as quickly as they've typically moved in the past.

triggers.label: Footfalls up low single digits
triggers.quote: we saw footfalls improving by low single digits.

triggers.label: No SSG guidance given
triggers.quote: I can't give you a particular guidance on what SSG do we aim to achieve for the next financial year

guidance.value: net openings in new FY, gross openings stable
guidance.quote: we will see net openings happening in the coming -- in the new financial year.
we do anticipate about 50 to 150 basis point increase in the total sort of this number
hopefully, by next earnings call, we will have a very concrete answer on this.

red_flags.label: Gap of retail to net sales widened to ~29%; GST-driven
red_flags.quote: the difference which we are looking at between the primary sales and the secondary sales, 71% and 73%

red_flags.label: Gross margin down ~150 bps in FY26
red_flags.quote: gross margin contraction of around 150 basis points during the year

evasions.quote: I can't give you a particular guidance on what SSG do we aim to achieve for the next financial year
I would not say the word -- number 30 yet.
